---
title: "Download MSMS"
---

The current release is **MSMS 2.6.1**. MSMS is free for non-commercial use;
commercial use needs a license (see [License](license.qmd)).

| Platform | File | Unpack with |
|---|---|---|
| Linux 64-bit | [Linux 64-bit tar file](https://github.com/sannerlab/downloads/releases/download/msms-2.6.1/msms_i86_64Linux2_2.6.1.tar.gz) | `tar zxvf msms_i86_64Linux2_2.6.1.tar.gz` |
| macOS before 10.14 (pre-Mojave) | [macOS tar file](https://github.com/sannerlab/downloads/releases/download/msms-2.6.1/msms_MacOSX_2.6.1.tar.gz) | `tar zxvf msms_MacOSX_2.6.1.tar.gz` |
| macOS 10.14 (Mojave) and later | [macOS tar file](https://github.com/sannerlab/downloads/releases/download/msms-2.6.1/msms_x86_64Darwin_2.6.1.tar.gz) | `tar zxvf msms_x86_64Darwin_2.6.1.tar.gz` |
| Arm64 | [Arm64 tar file](https://github.com/sannerlab/downloads/releases/download/msms-2.6.1/msms_Arm64_2.6.1.tgz) | `tar zxvf msms_Arm64_2.6.1.tgz` |
| Windows | [Windows zip file](https://github.com/sannerlab/downloads/releases/download/msms-2.6.1/msms_win32_2.6.1.zip) | extract the files from `msms_win32_2.6.1.zip` |

The files are on GitHub, in the
[msms-2.6.1 release](https://github.com/sannerlab/downloads/releases/tag/msms-2.6.1). See the [Documentation](documentation.qmd) for how to
run `msms`.
